project_scope.note: Current Matelea set after reconciling former Matelea biflora to Chthamalia biflora.

study_strategy.warning: Use the corona/gynostegium and follicle together with corolla pattern; flower color alone is weak.

quick_key.if: flat broad pale-green flower + strong dark net-reticulation + glabrous inner corolla + silvery center
more bell-shaped pale-green flower + longitudinal lines + hairy inner corolla + obvious fleshy corona segments
